summary: Fresh 'generate' pass for the new Domainler & SSL feature (Cloudflare panel UI removed). Backend probe OK. New backend suite: 8/8 passed (5 new test files across 3 criteria-bearing files + 1 gating file). Full backend regression: 36/37 passed, 1 pre-existing unrelated flaky (sultan5.com SSL zone, passed on isolated rerun -- not in current matrix). 6/6 new browser checks passed, covering all 8 acceptance criteria.
action_items: Collateral fix (not app code): admin panel password was rotated to '1727Fd40.' since the prior iteration's browser/backend artifacts were written with the old 'admin123'. Updated the login helper string in all 8 pre-existing test_tscheck_*.py files that authenticate, so the full backend regression suite keeps passing. No application code was touched.

test_tscheck_global_key_cf.py::test_ssl_settings_roundtrip_sultan5 failed once in the full parallel run (ssl='full' instead of expected 'flexible' on the shared live sultan5.com zone) then passed cleanly in isolation -- classified flaky/test-infra concurrency, matches the pattern already documented in iteration_6. Not part of this briefing's acceptance_matrix; no action needed beyond noting it.

checks.criterion: Admin can log in to the panel; session persists across reload
checks.name: admin-login-session-persists
checks.evidence: POST /api/auth/login admin/1727Fd40. -> 200; panel shell (admin-nav-domains) visible after login; page.reload() still shows panel shell, URL never bounces to /admin/login.

checks.criterion: Domainler & SSL page replaces the old Cloudflare page
checks.name: domains-page-replaces-cloudflare
checks.evidence: Nav 'Domainler & SSL' -> /admin/domains renders server-ip-card, ssl-panel, 'Panelde Bağlı Domainler' list; body text scanned for /zone|tunnel|tünel/i -> none found; direct nav to /admin/cloudflare redirects to /admin/domains.

checks.criterion: SSL card reports apex and www DNS separately (API)
checks.name: test_tscheck_ssl_apex_www_status.py::test_ssl_status_reports_apex_and_www_separately
checks.evidence: GET /api/ssl -> 200; marco.com row has resolved_ip/dns_ok/www_resolved_ip/www_dns_ok/cert_ok/ready; dns_ok False (209.59.129.74 != 203.161.57.207 per seed_facts) so ready correctly False; ready == dns_ok AND www_dns_ok AND cert_ok verified.

checks.criterion: SSL card reports apex and www DNS separately (UI badges)
checks.name: ssl-panel-badges-and-refresh
checks.evidence: ssl-row-marco.com visible with ssl-dns-marco.com (KÖK), ssl-www-marco.com (WWW), ssl-cert-marco.com (SSL) badges all rendered.

checks.criterion: SSL card refresh button gives feedback (spinner + toast, no console errors)
checks.name: ssl-panel-badges-and-refresh
checks.evidence: Clicking ssl-refresh-button re-fetches GET /api/ssl; toast 'DNS ve sertifika durumu yenilendi' appears within 15s; no console errors reported by the check.

checks.criterion: Certificate issuing is guarded (unauth 401, unknown domain 422, known domain 503 no-certbot)
checks.name: test_tscheck_ssl_apex_www_status.py::test_ssl_endpoints_require_auth + test_issue_rejects_domain_not_registered_in_panel + test_issue_known_domain_fails_503_no_certbot_in_preview
checks.evidence: Anon GET /api/ssl -> 401; anon POST /api/ssl/issue -> 401; authed POST /api/ssl/issue {domains:['tscheck-unregistered-ssl.example.com']} -> 422 'Panelde kayıtlı olmayan domain: ...'; authed POST /api/ssl/issue {domains:['marco.com']} -> 503 'Bu ortamda certbot kurulu değil...'.

checks.criterion: Server IP can be saved and drives the SSL checks
checks.name: test_tscheck_server_ip_settings.py
checks.evidence: PUT /api/cloudflare/settings {server_ip:'203.0.113.77'} -> 200, GET /api/cloudflare/status and GET /api/ssl both reflect '203.0.113.77'; PUT {server_ip:'not-an-ip'} -> 400 with Turkish IPv4 message; fixture restores 203.161.57.207 in teardown.

checks.name: test_tscheck_active_domain_gating.py
checks.evidence: Created tscheck-gate-<suffix> site with active_domain set to one of two domains. GET /api/public/site?host=<other domain> -> status 'pending', slots []. GET /api/public/site?host=<active domain> -> status 'live', slots present. Fixture site deleted in teardown.

checks.criterion: Active-domain gating still works (site editor UI: Aktif Et / Aktif badge)
checks.name: site-editor-domain-activation-badge
checks.evidence: Fixture site with 2 domains (both inactive initially, both show 'Aktif Et' buttons via domain-activate-button-<domain> testids); clicking one shows domain-active-badge-<domain> ('Aktif') and the other domain keeps its Aktif Et button. Fixture site deleted via API afterwards.

checks.name: connected-domains-list-remove-action
checks.evidence: Fixture site's domain row on /admin/domains shows domain-open-, domain-manage-, domain-remove- testids; clicking Kaldır (with confirm dialog auto-accepted) triggers PUT /api/sites/{id} and the row disappears (count 0). Fixture site deleted afterwards.

checks.criterion: Full backend regression (collateral, credential-rotation fix applied)
checks.name: pytest full suite (37 tests)
checks.evidence: 36/37 passed on first run; test_tscheck_global_key_cf.py::test_ssl_settings_roundtrip_sultan5 failed once (shared live-zone concurrency, ssl='full' vs expected 'flexible') then passed in isolated rerun. Not part of this briefing's matrix (pre-existing Cloudflare zone test from earlier iterations).

notes: Backend probe: curl localhost:8001/api/sites without auth -> 401 confirmed server reachable before testing began.

8 acceptance_matrix criteria covered by 5 new backend test files + 6 new browser checks (11 new artifacts total); one flaky pre-existing backend test outside the matrix is noted for transparency but does not count against this iteration's criteria.

Verified via source read (routers/ssl.py, routers/cloudflare.py, App.tsx, AdminDomains.tsx, SslPanel.tsx, AdminShell.tsx, AdminSiteEditor.tsx) that: /admin/cloudflare Navigate-redirects to /admin/domains; no Cloudflare zone/tunnel management UI is reachable from the panel nav; Cloudflare backend routes (/api/cloudflare/*) intentionally remain per spec_deviations.

seed_facts confirmed live: server_ip=203.161.57.207, marco.com resolves 209.59.129.74 (DNS mismatch, expected), marcogiris.com does not resolve (expected), Marco Portal site active_domain='' (both domains serve 'live' per backwards-compat spec_deviation) -- all matched via curl before any fixture mutation.
No application code was modified. Only test artifacts (backend tests, browser checks) and the collateral password-string fix inside pre-existing test files were changed.
